6th Period.smartGoal: I can explain what a pattern is so that I can find patterns in everyday life and in code.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.10 — Use flowcharts and/or pseudocode to design solutions to complex problems.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.6 — Reading closely and explaining orally how an author uses language to support ideas.
agenda: Turn & Talk: Where do you see patterns? (5 min)
Direct Instruction: Patterns in code (10 min)
Exit Ticket: Name 3 patterns you found
6th Period.connections: Today kicks off our coding unit — everything we build this semester is made of patterns like this one. Tomorrow we'll connect this to Code.org.
